name: Lemon-Artichoke Skillet Chicken Thighs
description: Crisp-skinned thighs finished in the oven over a lemony artichoke pan sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1 can artichoke hearts (14 oz, drained and quartered)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Pat chicken thighs very dry and season all over with salt and black pepper.

Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Lay the thighs in skin-side down and leave them alone until the skin is deep golden and crisp, 6-8 minutes. Flip, sear 1 minute more, and move to a plate.
Pour off all but about 1 tbsp of fat and lower the heat to medium. Add shallot and garlic and cook until soft, 2 minutes.
Pour in white wine and scrape up the browned bits. Simmer until reduced by half, 2 minutes.
Stir in chicken broth, artichoke hearts, dried oregano, and the zest of a lemon. Bring to a simmer.
Nestle the thighs back in skin-side up, keeping the skin above the liquid. Roast until the chicken reaches 175°F, 20-25 minutes. Put the asparagus in on another rack for the last 15 minutes.
Move the chicken to a plate. Set the skillet over medium (the handle is hot) and swirl in butter and the juice of the lemon. Simmer until glossy, 1-2 minutes, then taste for salt.
Spoon the sauce and artichokes around the chicken, not over it, so the skin stays crisp. Scatter with parsley.
Boneless, skinless thighs work too: sear 4 minutes a side and roast only 10-12 minutes. Crusty bread or orzo soaks up the sauce. Leftovers keep 3 days; the skin softens but the sauce is still good.
